userEnteredValue.stringValue: • 45 minutes a day: 15 min kettlebell warm-up, then 30 min of lifting in three supersets.
• Superset = do 1A, walk straight to 1B, rest, repeat. Labels 1A/1B, 2A/2B, 3A/3B are in column A; the Rest column says what's next and how long each superset takes. Set up each pair side by side.
• 1A is the heavy lift: two quick ramp-up sets, then 4 × 3–5, last set AMRAP. The 1B set fills its rest (~2.5 min).
• Each week gets its own tab (newest first), built automatically every Saturday at 7 am.
• Only the YELLOW cells are yours: Weight lifted, AMRAP reps (heavy lift's last set), ▶ Start KB / ⏹ Stop KB (tick to time the kettlebell warm-up) and the Workout complete checkbox.
• Tap an exercise name for its how-to video. The 🔔 row opens the kettlebell warm-up video and shows the day's time math.
• Heavy lift: weight goes up next week when the AMRAP set hits 5+ reps.
• Accessories: weight goes up when you tick Workout complete with a weight logged.
• Upper body +2.5–5 lb, legs +5–10 lb. Missed target → same weight next week.
• Typing a different weight than suggested makes YOUR number the new baseline.
• Ticking Workout complete emails a summary of the day (checked every 15 min, 5–11 am).

• Exercises rotate every 6 weeks (Block D → E → F). Belt squat is the heavy lift on both leg days. At the end of each block the plan recalculates from your InBody scan, weight, food log and lifts (see the Block Review tab). Saturday is rest.
• Daily Weight: log your weight every morning. A new week of dates appears each Saturday; the chart shows daily weigh-ins and the 7-day average. Each workout email includes that day's weight.

• Body Log: add your InBody scan, or paste a photo of the printout into Claude and it logs the row, including the body-part (segmental) readings. Daily calorie + protein targets update from your latest lean body mass.
• Nutrition: one row per weighed food (date, food, grams, calories, protein). Yesterday's totals and surplus/deficit go into the next workout email.
• Monthly Check-in: waist measurement + a link to that month's progress photos.
Exercises rotate to the next block after this many weeks.
Emailed each time a day is ticked complete.
Kettlebell videos are now per day type below.
TRUE from Saturday on (or before week 1), and only if next week's tab doesn't exist yet. The generator does nothing while FALSE.
Samuel Jordan – Chest & Triceps with One Kettlebell (15 min)
DanielPT Fitness – 15 min Pull Upper Body Kettlebell (slow-paced)
DanielPT Fitness – 15 min Kettlebell Leg & Glute (all standing)
45-minute superset plan. Blocks D → E → F rotate from this week.
